rollback: Not certified. pi-durable 1.3 writes pi.tool v2 tasks. Do not downgrade a mutated store to 1.0.0; restore a pre-upgrade storage backup and matching workspace checkpoints. Restoring application artifacts alone does not undo state changes.
restartPolicy: Application-only deploys normally hot-adopt. Runtime changes require a node restart; quiesce sessions and verify workspace checkpoints and an off-machine storage backup first.
validation: Automated checks include a copied pi-durable 1.0.0 SQLite fixture (history, safe pending tool, queued input), real Harness failure/reopen, and isolated deployment/UI/API/Sandbox adapter smoke. Stop during a running tool was validated live on an isolated node. Host upgrade/downgrade, real provider turns, terminal/preview, hot adoption and restart recovery still require the manual release checklist.
